## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] A model change comes with a migration, and `alembic check` is clean
- [ ] Docs are updated where this changes behaviour (`doc/apis.md` for the API)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under **Unreleased** for anything users would notice
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or `.env` values in the diff
